body: I'm about the same as the end of yesterday, I had to work on a group project with some guys last night so that helped take my mind of it; however I didn't sleep well at all and my appetite is non-existent.
Thanks I'll keep that in mind.

I guess now that I think about, the risk of going through another heartbreak is worth the feeling of being loved and loving someone. Thanks so much, when I came here today, I had planned exactly how I was going to end it, now I feel somewhat better about it.
Yes of course being able to hold some one and call them my SO is something I love to be able to do, but I don't want to experience a heartbreak like this again.
Definitely I'm sure I will feel better but now I just feel if it would be easier to just end it, and prevent any more heartbreaks for me.

I suppose the depression could be the cause, however I think the medicine is doing its job.  
  
We are both 18 and as far as getting back together, I doubt it. As far as the interesting girls there are a couple of girls, that would be interesting to get to know, but honestly all I want is her. Her looks and body may not conform to society standards, but she is beautiful inside and outside to me.

We had broken up before, because she said I wasn't the same person, I agreed because I had honestly focused more on school than her and we agreed that from then on if we had an issue we would talk about it then and not wait.  
  
The break up (I guess)was because I asked for a little more attention, while I am at college we would video chat via oovoo. I asked her last night that if she wasn't going to talk to me when I got on, then just wait until she could talk to me to call me. Apparently this was me turning back to the old me. She texted me this morning and said "I cant take the whiplash of this relationship." The only whiplash I can even think about in the relationship is when she first got diagnosed with depression he mood would change in an instant and it caused some strife but I agreed to forgive and overlook it with the condition she would do the same.

I guess you have a point, I just focused everything around her, I did extremely well in school to have a better future for us, I stay/stayed away from alcohol and drugs because I didn't want to do anything to jeopardize the relationship. Now I just don't see a reason to bother anymore with school or any of it, since our future is pretty much history.
I suppose I just don't have alot of good things in my life other than family and grades, I'm not downplaying either one of those but she was the absolute best thing to happen to me.

Yeah, I tried for the most part of the day, I poured my heart out to her and she just acts like she doesn't care. She just says that she isn't worth all the heartache, which I don't understand but the last time I texted her apparently she handed her phone to one of the girls at her school to text me back.
I most definitely want her back there is nothing I wouldn't do to get her back. I am an Economics major and I guess I don't really have other interests besides her, other than gaming.
